title: 26,725 postings → the ones you can get
post:
A job crawler that reads 26,725 postings to find the few a junior AI engineer in Pakistan can actually get.

349 sources (company boards on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable… plus open job APIs), robots.txt obeyed, LinkedIn never requested.
26,725 → 25,590 after dedup → 2,348 target AI titles → 1,422 without senior titles → 847 asking ≤2 years → 268 with a route from Pakistan; 524 in the by-country lens.
Every removal is counted with its reason.
#MachineLearning #Jobs #Python

title: One posting, field by field
input: xAI · AI Tutor - Croatian · Remote International
output: AI data work · remote, open to you
post:
How a job crawler decides whether one posting is open to you - field by field.

Posting: 'AI Tutor - Croatian' (xAI). It says 'remotely from any location worldwide' and also 'we are unable to provide visa sponsorship'.
Old rule: no sponsorship → closed. New rule: work open worldwide needs no visa, so only a citizenship or clearance rule closes it. 'For US-based candidates…' qualifies a group of hires; it doesn't lock the job to the US.
18 such roles came back.
#AI #Jobs #RegEx

title: 7 portfolios, read from sitemaps
input: Techstars · Antler · a16z · GC · Accel · Thrive · Insight
post:
Accelerator and VC portfolios, read politely: 6,354 companies and 4,600 AI postings from 7 programmes.

The board API disallows crawlers in robots.txt, so it isn't used. The boards' own sitemaps are allowed - and they put the job title in the address (/companies/<co>/jobs/<id>-<title>).
Techstars 2,859 companies, Antler 828, Accel 713, a16z 673, General Catalyst 548, Insight 532, Thrive 101.
#VentureCapital #Startups #Jobs
